guide.scenarios.finance.goal: Approve the Northwind invoice for payment

guide.scenarios.finance.steps.see: The invoice queue is open with items waiting
guide.scenarios.finance.steps.where: Invoices tab, first row of the queue
guide.scenarios.finance.steps.done: Invoice 4471 is open and the amount matches the purchase order

guide.scenarios.finance.steps.see: Invoice 4471 is open. Amount and PO number match
guide.scenarios.finance.steps.do: Set the approval route to Finance lead
guide.scenarios.finance.steps.where: The dropdown next to Status, not the Vendors menu
guide.scenarios.finance.steps.correct: Not that menu: it is the dropdown next to Status.

guide.scenarios.finance.steps.see: Route set, nothing left to fill
guide.scenarios.finance.steps.do: Click Approve, then confirm the amount in the dialog
guide.scenarios.finance.steps.done: Status shows Approved and the entry is in the audit log

guide.scenarios.finance.complete: Invoice 4471 approved and logged. Every step confirmed on screen.
guide.scenarios.logistics.goal: Book the carrier and print the labels for order 8820

guide.scenarios.logistics.steps.see: Order 8820 is packed: three cartons, ready to ship
guide.scenarios.logistics.steps.done: A draft shipment lists all three cartons

guide.scenarios.logistics.steps.do: Pick the Ground 2-day service, not Express
guide.scenarios.logistics.steps.where: The service dropdown next to Carrier
guide.scenarios.logistics.steps.correct: Not that service: Ground 2-day meets the delivery date and costs less.

guide.scenarios.logistics.steps.do: Book it and print the three labels
guide.scenarios.logistics.steps.done: Three labels printed and the tracking number is on the order

guide.scenarios.logistics.complete: Order 8820 booked, labels printed, tracking saved. Every step confirmed on screen.
guide.scenarios.healthcare.goal: Book the follow-up visit and send the pre-visit forms

guide.scenarios.healthcare.steps.see: Today's list is open and the 2:30 visit just finished
guide.scenarios.healthcare.steps.do: Open the Schedule and pick next Tuesday

guide.scenarios.healthcare.steps.see: Tuesday has open slots in the afternoon
guide.scenarios.healthcare.steps.do: Choose Follow-up, 20 minutes, with Dr. Lin
guide.scenarios.healthcare.steps.where: The dropdown next to Today, not the Patients menu
guide.scenarios.healthcare.steps.correct: Not that menu: it is the dropdown next to Today.

guide.scenarios.healthcare.steps.do: Send the pre-visit forms to the patient portal
guide.scenarios.healthcare.steps.done: The portal shows the forms as sent

guide.scenarios.healthcare.complete: Follow-up booked and forms sent. Every step confirmed on screen.
guide.scenarios.retail.goal: Set up the weekend promotion on every register

guide.scenarios.retail.steps.see: The back office is open on Sales
guide.scenarios.retail.steps.do: Create a new promotion called Weekend 15

guide.scenarios.retail.steps.see: The draft is open with no dates yet
guide.scenarios.retail.steps.do: Set it to run Saturday and Sunday only
guide.scenarios.retail.steps.where: The date picker next to Active, not the Staff menu
guide.scenarios.retail.steps.correct: Not that menu: the dates live next to Active.
guide.scenarios.retail.steps.done: The promotion shows Saturday to Sunday

guide.scenarios.retail.steps.do: Publish it to all three registers
guide.scenarios.retail.steps.done: All three registers show the promotion as live

guide.scenarios.retail.complete: Weekend promotion live on every register. Every step confirmed on screen.
guide.scenarios.hr.goal: Onboard Priya, who starts on Monday

guide.scenarios.hr.steps.see: The onboarding board is open with one new hire
guide.scenarios.hr.steps.do: Open Priya's record and set the start date to Monday

guide.scenarios.hr.steps.where: The dropdown next to Team, not the Payroll menu
guide.scenarios.hr.steps.correct: Not that menu: the checklist is the dropdown next to Team.

guide.scenarios.hr.steps.do: Send the welcome pack and the equipment request
guide.scenarios.hr.steps.done: Priya has the welcome pack and IT has the equipment request

guide.scenarios.hr.complete: Priya is set up for Monday. Every step confirmed on screen.
guide.scenarios.engineering.goal: Ship the hotfix through the release pipeline

guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.see: The hotfix branch is pushed and the checks are green
guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.do: Run the release pipeline on the hotfix branch
guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.done: The run is queued on the hotfix branch

guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.see: The run asks for a target environment
guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.where: The environment dropdown next to Run
guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.correct: Not that one: staging first. The smoke test gates production.
guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.done: Environment reads staging and the smoke test passed

guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.do: Promote the same build to production
guide.scenarios.engineering.steps.done: Production shows the hotfix build and the health checks pass

guide.scenarios.engineering.complete: Hotfix in production with checks green. Every step confirmed on screen.
guide.scenarios.support.goal: Escalate ticket 5190 with the right priority

guide.scenarios.support.steps.see: Ticket 5190 is open: a checkout outage for one customer
guide.scenarios.support.steps.where: The priority dropdown at the top of the ticket
guide.scenarios.support.steps.done: Priority reads High and the SLA timer updated

guide.scenarios.support.steps.do: Assign it to the Payments team
guide.scenarios.support.steps.where: The dropdown next to Assignee, not the Customers menu
guide.scenarios.support.steps.correct: Not that menu: it is the dropdown next to Assignee.

guide.scenarios.support.steps.do: Add the customer-facing update and send it
guide.scenarios.support.steps.done: The customer received the update and the ticket shows Escalated

guide.scenarios.support.complete: Ticket 5190 escalated and the customer informed. Every step confirmed on screen.
guide.scenarios.vendor.goal: Set up the new vendor in the payments portal

guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.see: The Vendors tab is open and the form is empty
guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.do: Click New vendor and enter the legal name
guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.done: The vendor record exists as a draft

guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.do: Set payment terms to Net 30, then enter the Tax ID
guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.where: The Terms dropdown, not the Customers tab
guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.correct: Wrong tab: back to Vendors, then set Terms to Net 30.
guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.done: Terms read Net 30 and the Tax ID is saved

guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.see: Terms and Tax ID are in
guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.do: Attach the signed W-9 and submit for approval
guide.scenarios.vendor.steps.done: The vendor is pending approval with the W-9 attached

guide.scenarios.vendor.complete: New vendor submitted for approval. Every step confirmed on screen.

benchmark.flow.t: A task with a known-correct answer
benchmark.flow.d: Written and held by us, part of the set kept private.
The same guidance a customer gets, no special path.
Mechanically where possible; an AI judge only otherwise, and flagged.
Pass rate, sample size and the 95% confidence interval, published together.

benchmark.ciP: A pass rate alone hides the sample size. The interval is published with it, so a thin domain reads as thin and a solid one as solid.
benchmark.ciAria: Illustration: two pass-rate bars with their confidence-interval whiskers, one wide from a thin sample, one narrow from a solid sample. No numbers.
